import csv
import json
import re

report = {

    "mean_age": round(statistics.mean(ages), 1),
    "by_city": dict(Counter(r["city"] for r in rows)),
    "domains": dict(domains.most_common()),
    "oldest": max(rows, key=lambda r: int(r["age"]))["name"],
}
